headline: Amber Enterprises India Limited: Acquisition
sum: Acquisition - Pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI LODR Regulations, 2015,  we would like to inform the exchange that Amber Enterprises India Limited has incorporated a new wholly owned subsidiary company in India, namely Amber Digital…
detail: Acquisition - Pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI LODR Regulations, 2015,  we would like to inform the exchange that Amber Enterprises India Limited has incorporated a new wholly owned subsidiary company in India, namely Amber Digital Technologies Private Limited.
